poll.source_locator: Report p.1 '2026 Senate Election': with leaners, Jackson 54, Collins 45, another <1, undecided <1 (recorded 0); methodology p.9: Oct 27-31, 1,654 likely voters. Read in Max's Chrome 2026-11-02 ~08:45 PST (the PDF answers a browser; curl gets a Cloudflare 403).
poll.notes: PRIMARY VERIFIED 2026-11-02 on the UNH report PDF. The UNH report PDF https://scholars.unh.edu/cgi/viewcontent.cgi?article=2012&context=survey_center_polls returned a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403) to curl and WebFetch on 2026-11-02; not bypassed. The landing page https://scholars.unh.edu/survey_center_polls/1013/ (reachable) confirms the poll and the 11-1-2026 publication but gives no numbers. Numbers, n and dates come from the Wikipedia general-election row citing that landing page, and agree with 270toWin ('Univ. of New Hampshire', 11/01/2026) and PollCheck. Integrator: verify on the PDF before ingesting, or hold. Landing-page title: 'Jackson Opens Lead Over Collins in Maine Senate Race, LePage Ahead in CD2 11/1/2026'. Other 0 / Undecided 0 summing to 99 suggests a pushed or ranked-choice-resolved ballot; round and denominator could not be read (round UNVERIFIED; prior UNH Maine row was FIRST).

pollster.weighting_quote: Data were weighted by respondent sex, age, education, and region of the state to targets from the most recent American Community Survey (ACS) conducted by the U.S. Census Bureau, as well as party registration levels provided by the ME Secretary of State and to 2024 election results in Maine.
